# Load required libraries
library(neuralnet)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Create sample dataset (100 points with 2 features)
sample_data <- data.frame(
  x1 = runif(100, 0, 1),  # feature 1 (random values between 0-1)
  x2 = runif(100, 0, 1)   # feature 2 (random values between 0-1)
)

# Create target variable: points where x1+x2>1 belong to class 1, others to class 0
# Adding noise makes the classification task more realistic
sample_data$y <- with(sample_data, 
  ifelse(x1 + x2 + rnorm(100, 0, 0.1) > 1, 1, 0))

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
head(sample_data)
